# Copilot Instructions — Cerebral Synergy

## Project identity
Cerebral Synergy is an immersive creative and philosophical institution built around **Alchemical Futurism**: ancient wisdom, mythology, art, music, storytelling, AI, technology, and transformational inquiry.

It may contain art, digital artifacts, music/sound, stories, essays, experiments, interactive experiences, AI-assisted experiences, symbolic systems, creative technology, and connected creative worlds.

**Elaria is separate.** Do not merge Elaria wellness interfaces, quizzes, user systems, or branding into Cerebral Synergy unless explicitly requested.

## Experience principle
The site should feel **discovered, not browsed**.

## Tone requirements
- Mysterious but understandable
- Intelligent but accessible
- Spiritual but without unverified medical/supernatural claims
- Cinematic yet usable
- Ancient and futuristic simultaneously
- Experimental and technically polished

## Avoid
- Generic SaaS/portfolio templates
- Excessive glassmorphism, random glowing cards, generic galaxy backdrops
- Fake Latin, meaningless sacred geometry, unreadable decorative body typography
- Manipulative urgency patterns
- Autoplay audio
- Heavy animation that harms performance/accessibility
- Presenting speculation as established fact
- Merchandise-first framing

## Engineering requirements
- Use Next.js App Router conventions
- Prefer Server Components; use Client Components only when interaction requires them
- Keep navigation clear and accessible
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`
- No fake external links or fake social accounts
- No unnecessary tracking or cookie prompts by default
- Do not expose secrets in client bundles
